integrity: Scientific conclusions are supported by explicit finite computations and cited published nonequivariant homology; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the natural affine subgroup of automorphisms of the Paley tournament of order 23 is analyzed.
The nonequivariant integral torsion order relies on Govc’s published 2020 classification; the new modular eigenvalue is exactly checked by included code.
No other primes, tournament orders or homology degrees are classified.
Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Inverse-multiplier action on the order-\(23\) torsion of the Paley tournament complex
